questions: An insurer needs: (1) partners submitting claims via REST, (2) guaranteed handoff to a mainframe claims system over MQ, (3) real-time claim events for fraud analytics with 30-day replay, and (4) self-service partner access to selected claim-status events. Which capability mapping is BEST?

(1) API Connect with the DataPower API Gateway and an ACE implementation, (2) IBM MQ with persistent messages, (3) Event Streams topics with 30-day retention and Event Processing for analytics, (4) Event Endpoint Management with an Event Gateway
(1) Event Streams, (2) API Connect, (3) MQ, (4) Aspera
Use ACE for everything, including storing events for 30 days
Use MQ for all four requirements
Each requirement maps to the capability designed for it: governed APIs, assured messaging, retained event streams with processing, and governed event exposure.
Correct: the right capability for each requirement.
Wrong: ACE is not an event store.
Wrong: MQ does not provide replayable streams or event socialization.
The final solution uses five CP4I capabilities, each in its sweet spot.
Map each requirement to its capability, then connect them.
